## 维护者速读
- 用户无感:规格包里"关联条件过滤"的说明文字改为按查询动作与数据库驱动分别说明,运行行为不变。
- 属于过滤语法文档准确性收口,替用 MongoDB 等驱动写过滤条件的开发者和 AI 助手解决被旧说明误导的问题。
- 只改说明文字,出错时最坏是文字仍不准确,不影响任何数据或请求,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes
The form 4 (nested relation) paragraph of the `FilterCondition` docblock in `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`, prose only, measured against `origin/main` cceb5c62:

- **"the same on every driver" removed.** On a read verb (`find`, `findOne`, `count`, `aggregate`) a single-valued relation is one subquery inside the read's own statement where that is provably the same read; a multi-valued relation, `update`, `delete`, and a read the subquery cannot prove read the related ids. Measured: `SEMI_JOIN_READ_VERBS` and the `!site.multiple` test in `packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts` (`relationReadDriverRefusal`) and `packages/objectql/src/engine-query-lowering.ts` (`lowerRelationConditions`, the semi-join branch).
- **Refusal named.** A driver without `DriverCapabilities.readableIdsLeaf` (MongoDB, OData) refuses a single-valued condition on a read verb up front, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, citing ADR-0139 D3 as amended 2026-11-17 ("A nested-relation condition beneath a single-valued relation on a read verb is refused up front on a driver without it, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400"). A multi-valued relation and the write verbs keep the capped id read there (`relationReadDriverRefusal` returns early for both).
- **Cap sentence scoped** to "Where ids are read", naming `RELATION_FILTER_ID_CAP`.

`content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` already states the same (its "the same on every driver that serves it" paragraph and the `readableIdsLeaf` refusal paragraph) and was measured correct, so it is untouched. No generated reference copies the sentence (`git grep "same on every driver"` hits only this file and unrelated pages). One `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/spec` (the file ships in `files[]`).

Read first: `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` form 4 paragraph (the only risk: a sentence that disagrees with the engine).

Two-minute check: `git grep -n "same on every driver" packages/spec/src` answers nothing.

## Tests
Text only; no tests added and no ablation (no tested behaviour changed). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes
- ADR-0155 D1 (named by the dispatch) governs the share-grant leaf, not this author-written form; nothing from it is quoted in the docblock.
